Resolves #20018

A tear-out released after its vessel has loaded now commits with a clean receipt. In that order, the owner change and the commit both bind the vessel window, and `registerVesselWorkspaceTarget` mounted twice. The first mount retired the provisional chrome once the projection had moved the pane out. The second found no chrome, so `retireProvisionalVesselChrome` returned `false`, and it threw "left its pane in provisional chrome" over a commit that had landed. A second binding of the same window now joins the mount in flight (`state.mountInFlight`). `mountPromise` keeps the last outcome, as on dev: a later binding of a host a failed mount had parented still reports that failure, which Euclid caught at the first head. The trace is on the ticket: https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20018#issuecomment-6359998732

Evidence: L3 (local Chromium e2e, the new late-release arm red-first; unit arm red-first) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-3 are local runs). See Test Evidence.

Head: 5 of 5 green. |

"a second binding of the vessel window joins the mount in flight": dev mounts twice (`Received length: 2`), head mounts once. "a mount that parented the host and failed keeps reporting the failure": green on dev, red at the first head 009dd26cbd, green at 216141b840. |

## Deltas from ticket
- The ticket inferred an arrival-order race inside `mountVesselWorkspace`, and a re-render instead of a DOM move. Neither holds. The arm marks the staged DOM node before the release, and the node keeps its mark through the commit on dev too, so the pane already moves. The defect was a duplicate mount, fixed where the second binding enters.
- AC-1 says "`applied === true` with `errors` empty". A successful tear-out writes no receipt (`lastCrossWindowTransfer` stays `null`; only failures write it), so the arm asserts `null`.
- The arm's release condition is the staged pane in the vessel's DOM, not `domcontentloaded` + 1.5 s. A condition holds on every machine where a timer only moves the window.

## Test Evidence
- Local unit, `test/playwright/unit/apps/workstation`: 246 passed at 216141b840. The late-release arm ×3: green.
